shell_commands: npm run prettier -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -10

git add package.json package-lock.json src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat(tools): validate tool input against inputSchema at registration and execution time

Adds AJV-based JSON Schema validation to ToolRegistry. Static tool schemas are compiled
at registration time (throws on invalid schema), and input is validated before executor
invocation. Validation failures return a ToolResponse with an error message naming the
failing field and constraint, without echoing values. Function-valued tool definitions
have their schemas validated per call using a WeakMap cache for compiled validators.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main

npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && git commit -m "docs(tools): add one-line doc comment to execute method

References specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md for the validation contract.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"

git add .lore/dod.md && git commit -m "chore: update dod.md - mark facets 1-3 complete

Schema compilation, input validation, and documentation are implemented.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git push origin HEAD
